security.title: How secure is msnnext?
security.lead: It is designed to protect conversations and files without entrusting them to a central server.
security.item1.title: Encryption between devices
security.item1.desc: Messages, nudges and files are encrypted with XChaCha20-Poly1305; any relay nodes cannot read their content.
security.item2.title: Hybrid post-quantum protection
security.item2.desc: The key exchange combines X25519 and ML-KEM-768: if either protection stays secure, the session stays protected.
security.item3.title: Protected local data
security.item3.desc: History and received attachments are encrypted on the device; the identity key is kept by the operating system.
security.caveatBody: The IP address and connection times may be visible to participants; this version is still in development and has not received an independent audit.
